g.text: 1. Function: the FH35C-51S faceplate connector (t1 faceplate interface v1): DSI, I2C3, SPI/DBI,

g.desc: 1. Function: the FH35C-51S faceplate connector (t1 faceplate interface v1): DSI, I2C3, SPI/DBI,

g.text: touch, panel, interrupts, status LED, PDM, detect, spares, power; 5 contacts reserved.

g.desc: touch, panel, interrupts, status LED, PDM, detect, spares, power; 5 contacts reserved.

g.text: 2. Absent state: faceplate detached: FP_DET_N reads high (absent); FP_IO_EN low keeps FP_3V3

g.desc: 2. Absent state: faceplate detached: FP_DET_N reads high (absent); FP_IO_EN low keeps FP_3V3

g.text: (TPS22950 QOD) and FP_1V8 (10 kΩ discharge, the TPS22945 has none) off.

g.desc: (TPS22950 QOD) and FP_1V8 (10 kΩ discharge, the TPS22945 has none) off.

g.text: 3. Fault ceilings (t1 ADR 0005): FP_3V3 0.4 A (ILIM 0.22-0.38 A, UNVERIFIED at 3.57 kΩ),

g.desc: 3. Fault ceilings (t1 ADR 0005): FP_3V3 0.4 A (ILIM 0.22-0.38 A, UNVERIFIED at 3.57 kΩ),

g.text: FP_1V8 0.2 A (100-200 mA at 3.3 V; limit at 1.8 V UNVERIFIED, SLVS832D §7.5).

g.desc: FP_1V8 0.2 A (100-200 mA at 3.3 V; limit at 1.8 V UNVERIFIED, SLVS832D §7.5).

g.text: 4. FP_DET_N 10 kΩ pull-up and the spares' 100 kΩ pull-downs: capture choices. The TPS22950

g.desc: 4. FP_DET_N 10 kΩ pull-up and the spares' 100 kΩ pull-downs: capture choices. The TPS22950

g.text: FLT output is left open (auto-retry; the fault shows as FP_3V3 low): open item.

g.desc: FLT output is left open (auto-retry; the fault shows as FP_3V3 low): open item.

g.text: 5. Contacts 47-51 reserved (47, next to BL_LEDA, never a logic line). Contact numbering

g.desc: 5. Contacts 47-51 reserved (47, next to BL_LEDA, never a logic line). Contact numbering

g.text: against the Hirose drawing: pinout v1 §8.1.

g.desc: against the Hirose drawing: pinout v1 §8.1.

g.text: 6. Links (power tree §4.12): #23 FP_3V3, 0.1 Ω (80 mA, 8 mV); #31 FP_1V8, 1 Ω (5 mA, 5 mV).

g.desc: 6. Links (power tree §4.12): #23 FP_3V3, 0.1 Ω (80 mA, 8 mV); #31 FP_1V8, 1 Ω (5 mA, 5 mV).

g.text: 7. ESD at the connector: DSI CLK and D0-D3 on 3 x TPD4E05U06 (line 72, 0.42-0.5 pF, one pair per

g.desc: 7. ESD at the connector: DSI CLK and D0-D3 on 3 x TPD4E05U06 (line 72, 0.42-0.5 pF, one pair per

g.text: two channels); 20 low-speed lines on 5 x TPD4E05U06 and FP_GPIO1 on a TPD1E10B06 (line 75).

g.desc: two channels); 20 low-speed lines on 5 x TPD4E05U06 and FP_GPIO1 on a TPD1E10B06 (line 75).

g.text: ESD: 5 x TPD4E05U06 low-speed, 20 lines (BOM v1 line 75); 3 x TPD4E05U06 DSI, 10 lines (line 72)

g.desc: ESD: 5 x TPD4E05U06 low-speed, 20 lines (BOM v1 line 75); 3 x TPD4E05U06 DSI, 10 lines (line 72)

g.text: FH35C-51S-0.3SHW, contacts per pinout v1 §8.2 (BOM v1 line 71)
